title: 지정재판부의 구성과 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Allocation to Panels) The members of each Panel shall be assigned by the President of the Constitutional Court to Columns Ga, Na, and Da as set forth in the attached Table, following a resolution of the Conference of Justices: Provided, That where it is impossible to obtain such a resolution due to vacancies of three or more Justices or their inability to perform duties, the President of the Constitutional Court may make the assignments after consultation with the Justices. <Amended on April 17, 1998; July 19, 2019>
